Hi Priyom,

We're pleased with the platform performance but the budget committee just pushed back on the renewal number. We need to bring annual cost down by ~22% or get stronger contractual SLAs to justify the spend. Without one of those, we'll have to evaluate other solutions.

Specific asks from procurement:
- 20% off list for year 1 (they will consider step-ups in year 2)
- A 99.9% monthly uptime SLA or a credit mechanism that is meaningful to us
- Option to pause embedding ingestion for 30 days if usage spikes suddenly

We understand this is non-standard. Can you confirm whether Redwood can put an interim concession on the table to bridge us to renewal? We can sign a short amendment this week if needed.

Thanks,
Elena

Subject: Fwd: Contract renewal — Cella.ai — request for senior sign-off

Team — urgent escalation. Customer Cella.ai (DL-2026-081) is asking for either ~20% discount for year 1 or a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA + pause option. They gave us a hard decision window (committee reviews Wed 5 Aug).

Details and my recommended bridge:
- Offer a time-limited 18% retention discount (applies to year 1, non-recurring) + 3-month pilot at this price, to be reviewed at renewal.
- Add an SLA addendum: 99.9% monthly uptime, with a max 10% credit ladder for severe outages (document attached).
- Include a temporary "usage pause" clause limited to 30 days per 12-month period for ingestion, with an agreed notification window.

Why this? Keeps ARR close to plan, avoids entrenched multi-year price reset, gives them stronger contractual assurance, and is reversible at full renewal.

Asks: finance approval for the 18% discount cap, legal review on the pause clause (risk of data ingress/egress), and exec sign-off for one-time concession if needed. If we don't approve something in range, the customer will start an RFP.

Attachments: Cella_Save_Package_Q3_v3.pdf (proposal draft)

Can one of you confirm authority to approve or route? Prefer an answer today so I can send the amendment before their committee meets.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Contract renewal — Cella.ai — request for senior sign-off

Priyom —

I reviewed the attach and ran quick downside math with finance. Recommendation: approve the 18% one-time retention discount (conditional on a 12-month term, paid upfront or with a deposit), and approve the SLA addendum limited to the credit ladder language you proposed. Legal to tighten the pause clause: make it operationally gated (we need to be able to deny pause if it impacts multi-tenant performance) and limit the pause to non-real-time pipelines only.

We should also attach a clause that any usage spike which causes the pause request must include a remediation/optimization plan and a commitment to a minimum reinstatement fee if the pause is abused.

Approved as follows (executive sign-off):
- One-time, non-recurring 18% discount for year 1 (Deal Desk to capture in billing)
- SLA addendum: 99.9% monthly uptime with defined credit ladder (max 10% credit in a given month)
- Usage pause: allowed up to 30 calendar days per rolling 12 months, subject to operational review; non-real-time ingestion only; require 10 business days notice.

Priyom, send the amendment to Elena this morning with the DocuSign link. David — please confirm billing/finance treatment and record the concession. Aditya — loop Legal to tidy the pause clause.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
